description: A Chrome extension for tracking daily goals with timers, counters, and checkboxes. See FEATURES.md for full specifications.

userStories.title: Streamline goal cards
userStories.description: Make sure all goalcards have consistent styling. Progress bars colors should be every consistent across all goal types. Progress path is currently not visible is dark mode, give it some lighter shade. Fix all hover state issue, eg. if i over over some icon, the text and the color both changes to dark color, fix it so that they are more consistent

userStories.title: Enhance dark mode visibility
userStories.description: Improve the visibility of progress paths in dark mode by using lighter shades. Ensure that all elements are easily distinguishable and maintain a consistent color scheme across the extension.

userStories.title: Fix hover state inconsistencies
userStories.description: Review and correct hover state behaviors for all interactive elements. Ensure that text and icon colors change appropriately on hover to enhance user experience and maintain visual consistency.

userStories.title: Conduct comprehensive UI review
userStories.description: Perform a thorough review of the entire user interface to identify and address any additional inconsistencies or issues. Ensure that the overall design is cohesive and user-friendly.

userStories.title: Fix activity timeline in report
userStories.description: Now its 1am, and still i dont see today in the timeline, some utc issue?, use local time to add new day in timeline. also make the chart also almost full width, and in Y, just give starting 2 initals of the day, eg Mo, Tu, We, Th, Fr, Sa, Su in caps

userStories.title: Improve timeline and chart display
userStories.description: Ensure that the activity timeline correctly reflects the current day by addressing any potential UTC issues. Adjust the chart to utilize nearly the full width of the display and modify the Y-axis labels to show only the first two initials of each day (e.g., Mo, Tu, We, Th, Fr, Sa, Su) in uppercase for better readability.

userStories.title: New Achievements unlock
userStories.description: I dont like the achivement announcement popup, its too intrusive, instead add a small toast notification at the bottom left corner that says 'Achievement Unlocked: <achievement name>' and disappears after 3 seconds with some nice confetti animation.

userStories.title: Weekly Overview bars color
userStories.description: Weekly overviews are not using correct colors according to the theme

userStories.title: Enhance weekly review goal performance section
userStories.description: Improve the goal performance section in the weekly review by providing clearer insights and visualizations. Ensure that the data presented is easy to understand and helps users track their progress effectively.

userStories.title: Refine daily breakdown display
userStories.description: In the weekly review's daily breakdown section, remove the percentage display at the bottom by default. Instead, implement a feature that shows the percentage only when the user hovers over the respective section, enhancing clarity and reducing visual clutter.
